items.statement: The submission optimizes the explicitly defined neutral and monocation and documents valid charge/multiplicity and energy provenance.
items.expected: Neutral singlet and monocation doublet are converged with explicit state identity.

items.statement: The investigation constructs and validates individual paths to CHF2+ + Cl and CHFCl+ + F, reporting coverage and why the chosen path representation is adequate.
items.expected: Each fixed channel has an auditable continuous separated endpoint and per-channel validation context.

items.statement: The source-supported adiabatic first ionization energy is approximately 11.9 eV.
The source-supported CHF2+ + Cl appearance energy is approximately 12.4 eV.
The source-supported CHFCl+ + F appearance energy is approximately 13.5 eV.
